experiment.hypothesis: Freezing requested, executed, and fallback Route diagnostics makes the shared A/B seam truthful without changing retrieval order or dialogue policy.

diagnostic_fields_appended.requested_route_weights: object mapping lexical, structured, and dense to finite non-negative requested weights; Strategy.semantic_weight maps to dense
diagnostic_fields_appended.executed_routes: ordered unique list of non-empty Route names that actually executed
diagnostic_fields_appended.fallback_route: actual fallback Route name, or null when reported execution did not fall back

shared_contract.missing_data_semantics: Empty requested_route_weights plus empty executed_routes means a legacy producer did not report AB1 semantics; fallback_route null is conclusive only when executed_routes is non-empty.
shared_contract.backward_compatibility: Fields are appended with {}, [], and null defaults, preserving the original RetrievalDiagnostics positional signature.

known_risks: AB1 improves truthfulness and observability, not ranking quality; metric parity is the keep gate.
The retained default still does not execute dense retrieval even when Browsing Strategy requests a non-zero semantic weight.
Legacy injected retrievers may leave the appended diagnostics empty, which must be treated as unreported rather than executed or failed.
